denominator.instrument: f51_census.py --gates (mechanical, line-based); the 23 files with the strongest photometric content were then read individually
denominator.stated_limit: the mechanical selector is line-based: a gate whose comparison sits on a continuation line is invisible to it
denominator.note_on_the_47: 45 = the 46 files whose photometric comparison the mechanical filter caught, minus this task's own two; PLUS f18_disc.py and f18_gate.py, which read pixels and classify by ratio but whose comparison sits on a line the keyword filter does not match - a live instance of the stated line-based limit, found by reading

criterion.FLAGGED: some gate decides on pixel VALUES of a body drawn with an image texture AND its threshold is a CONSTANT (not a same-run ratio/floor/existence) AND its recorded numbers come from a pre-2026-08-26 run
criterion.FLAGGED-WEAK: same-run DIFFERENCE count on a textured body compared to an ABSOLUTE constant - real exposure (a diff of two dimmer, flatter frames crosses a fixed |delta|>N less often; measured: F48's b20 shadow witness 2790 -> 2313, -17%), but the margin is usually large
criterion.CLEAR: the disqualifying clause is named per member
criterion.no_re_baselining: forbidden by the mandate and unjustified while the carrier is unattributed
